title: Agent handoff report
description: Written by every agent before it exits, to $TASK_DIR/reports/<stage>-<role|subtask>.json. This is the only report envelope, and it is what leaves your worktree besides your commits. Absence of a valid report means the agent crashed.

subtask.description: Job id from plan.md, e.g. st-2-combat-hooks. Required for the implement stage.

status.description: complete = did the job and verified it. blocked = cannot proceed, nothing further to try. escalate = stuck, and whoever dispatched you should decide what to do. Both blocked and escalate end the job and hand this report back whole; nothing downstream retries you on a stronger model or rewrites your job.

summary.description: One paragraph for whoever reads this next: what changed, what surprised you, what they must know. Not a restatement of the task.

artifacts_written.description: Paths of every file created or modified: repo-relative for code, absolute (or $TASK_DIR-relative) for task artifacts.

signals.description: Why you stopped, when you stopped. Read whole by whoever dispatched you and summarised away by nothing in between, so this is where the detail belongs.

detail.description: What is wrong, citing an artifact and line where applicable.

evidence.description: Real command output or a concrete file reference. Never paraphrased or invented.

attempted.description: What you already tried and why it failed, so the next agent does not repeat it.

evidence.description: What you actually ran. At least one field is required: an honest not_verified is a legal answer, silence is not.

tests.description: Real result line, e.g. '214 passed, 0 failed'.

not_verified.description: Checks deliberately skipped, and why. Honesty here is required, not optional.

confidence.description: Advisory only. Nothing routes on it.

role_data.description: Anything your role card asks for that is not a field above.
